blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Research agents achieve increasingly strong benchmark scores, yet these scores do not necessarily translate into reliable delivery in ongoing research projects. Many research-agent benchmarks emphasize standalone tasks and relatively self-contained workflows in clean or curated workspaces. However, researchers ask agents to complete one step within an ongoing project, where requests depend on earlier session decisions and workspaces contain unfinished files, outdated versions, and failed attempts. We introduce ARE-bench to evaluate whether research agents advance ongoing projects while respecting prior decisions and existing workspace state, grounded in real session context and in-progress workspaces. ARE-bench includes 75 tasks built on agent sessions and full workspaces from recruited researchers' own projects, spanning seven research stages, 33 requirements, and 150 sub-requirements, with 1,173 binary checklist items in total. Each task is anchored at a real user request, preserves its requirements, and summarizes the earlier requests still in effect as background. The complete workspace is replayed to that boundary without cleanup, preserving artifacts from earlier turns. Each checklist is compiled from an intent-aligned rubric and credits any valid solution. Across seven frontier models, the strongest passes every checklist item on only 66.2% of tasks, and Design and Execution rank among the hardest stages for every model. Three models pass about 69% of tasks when only delivery contracts and general norms are checked, but just 28.4% to 40.0% once historical and material or workspace requirements are also checked. Evaluating delivery without these contextual requirements can therefore overestimate research agents and mask differences between them.
blocks.zh: 研究人员的分数越来越高,但这些分数不一定转化为正在进行的研究项目的可靠交付。 许多研究代理基准都强调在清洁或整理的工作空间中独立的任务和相对自成一体的工作流程. 然而,研究人员要求代理人在进行中的项目中完成一步,其中请求取决于之前的会话决定,工作空间包含未完成的文件,过时的版本和失败的尝试. 我们采用ARE-bench来评价研究人员是否在尊重先前的决定和现有工作空间状态的同时推进进行中的项目,并基于实际会议背景和进行中的工作空间。 ARE-bench包括75项基于代理会议的任务和来自被招聘研究人员自己项目的全部工作空间,涉及7个研究阶段、33个要求和150个次级要求,共有1 173个二进制清单项目。 每项任务都是应真正的用户要求而确定的,保留了各项要求,并总结了以前提出的仍为有效的要求。 完整的工作空间在不进行清理的情况下被重放到该边界,从更早的转弯处保存出文物. 每份核对表均由意向对应标题汇编,并计入任何有效解决办法。 在7个前沿模型中,最强者仅通过66.2%的任务的每个清单项目,设计和执行是每个模型最困难的阶段之一。 三种模式在只检查交货合同和一般规范时通过约69%的任务,但一旦检查历史和材料或工作空间要求,只有28.4%至40.0%。 因此,在没有这些背景要求的情况下评价交付情况,可能会高估研究代理人并掩盖它们之间的差异。

blocks.en:
High research-agent benchmark scores can give an incomplete picture of reliable delivery in real research projects.
For example, Qwen reports a score of 93.0% for Qwen3.8-Max on PaperBench Code-Dev ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) .
This variant assesses code development without checking execution or whether the paper’s empirical results are reproduced ( Starace et al., 2025 ) .
Even a near-ceiling score on this assessment therefore leaves important aspects of research delivery untested.
blocks.zh:
高研究代理基准分数可以给出真实研究项目可靠交付的不完整图景.
例如,Quen在Paper Bench Code-Dev(Quen Team,2026)上报告,Quen3.8-Max的得分为93.0%.
该变体在没有检查执行情况的情况下评估代码的开发情况,或者该文件的经验结果是否被复制(Starace等人,2025年)。
因此,即使这一评估的得分接近最高,研究提供的重要方面仍未经过测试。

blocks.en:
Many established research-agent benchmarks emphasize standalone objectives, such as Kaggle competitions ( Chan et al., 2024 ) , research engineering ( Wijk et al., 2024 ) , or full paper replication ( Starace et al., 2025 ) .
In ongoing projects, researchers also ask agents to handle an individual request, such as repairing a script after a failed run or adding a table to a paper. Success then depends on both the requested change and the prior session decisions and workspace artifacts that the change must respect.
Standalone objectives and curated starting states can leave this ability to advance an existing project underexamined, even when they rigorously assess their intended outcomes.
We therefore evaluate whether research agents advance ongoing projects while respecting prior decisions and existing workspace state, along two dimensions, real session context and in-progress workspaces .
blocks.zh:
许多既定的研究代理基准强调独立的目标,例如Kaggle竞赛(Chan等人,2024年),研究工程(Wijk等人,2024年),或完整的论文复制(Starace等人,2025年).
在进行中的项目中,研究人员也要求代理人处理单个请求,比如在运行失败后修复一个脚本或者在纸上添加一个表格. 因此,成功与否取决于所要求的更改和上届会议的决定以及变动必须尊重的工作空间文物。
独立的目标和经过治理的起步状态可能使推动现有项目的能力得不到审查,即使它们严格评估其预期成果。
因此,我们评估研究人员是否在尊重先前的决定和现有工作空间状况的同时,从两个方面,即实际会议背景和进行中的工作空间,推进进行中的项目。

blocks.en:
First, real session context supports evaluating whether agents carry earlier decisions into the current delivery.
Real research sessions switch between task types ( Slinko et al., 2026 ) , returning to literature review after experiments or adding experiments during paper writing (Figure 2 , top).
A request to fix a failed experiment may still require preserving methodological choices established during an earlier design discussion. Summarizing still-effective earlier requests as Background makes these constraints available for evaluating whether the agent integrates them with the current request.
blocks.zh:
首先,真实的会话背景支持评估代理人是否将先前的决定带入目前的交付.
真正的研究会话在任务类型之间切换(Slinko等人,2026年),在实验后返回文献审查或在写纸过程中加入实验(图2,顶部).
要求修复一个失败的实验仍可能需要保留在早先的设计讨论中确定的方法选择。 总结早期仍然有效的请求,作为背景,这些限制可以用来评估代理商是否将它们与当前请求融为一体。

blocks.en:
Second, in-progress workspaces support evaluating whether agents change existing artifacts while preserving their scientific meaning.
Clean or curated starting states simplify this setting, whereas ongoing projects can contain temporary files, outdated versions, and failed attempts that require checking which artifacts and conventions remain applicable (Figure 2 , bottom).
For example, in our CylindFormer repair task, two executions both resume training with nonzero loss and parameter updates, yet pass 20/20 and 16/20 checklist items, respectively. The latter changes coordinate handling, overlap labels, and matching losses required by the reference paper in the workspace (Figure 7 ). Restoring execution alone therefore does not establish that a repair preserves the research method.
blocks.zh:
第二,在建工作空间支持评估物剂是否在保留其科学意义的同时改变现有文物。
清理或整理的起始状态简化了这种设置,而进行中的项目可能包含临时文件、过时版本和失败的尝试,这些尝试需要检查哪些文物和公约仍然适用(图2,底部)。
例如,在我们CylindFormer修复任务中,两次处决都以非零损失和参数更新恢复训练,但分别通过了20/20和16/20核对清单项目。 后一种变化是协调处理、重叠标签和匹配工作空间参考文件所要求的损失(图7)。 因此,仅仅恢复执行并不能确定修复是否保留研究方法。

blocks.en: Recent benchmarks also incorporate real developer sessions ( Lv et al., 2026 ; Jha et al., 2026 ) or fine-grained research tasks ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . Our focus is on jointly evaluating the still-effective requirements of a real research request and the in-progress workspace in which that request arose.
blocks.zh: 最近的基准还包括真正的开发者会议(Lv等人,2026年;Jha等人,2026年)或精细的研究任务(Wang等人,2026a年)。 我们的重点是共同评估实际研究请求的仍然有效的要求和产生这一请求的进行中的工作空间。

blocks.en:
We introduce ARE-bench to evaluate this ability.
ARE-bench includes 75 tasks spanning seven research stages (Survey, Design, Data & Env., Code, Execution, Analysis, and Writing), 33 requirements, and 150 sub-requirements, with 1,173 binary checklist items in total.
We collect agent sessions and full workspaces from recruited researchers’ own projects.
For session context, we select a real user request as the task boundary, retain its requirements, and use the Background section to summarize the earlier requests still in effect, covering 10.3 earlier requests on average.
For in-progress workspaces, we replay the complete workspace to that boundary without cleaning, preserving 41.1 files per task on average, with agent-written files from earlier turns in 65.3% of tasks. The actor receives only the instruction and workspace, and an intent-aligned rubric compiles into the checklist that credits any valid solution.
blocks.zh:
我们引入ARE-bench来评估这种能力.
ARE-bench包括75项任务,涉及7个研究阶段(调查、设计、数据与信息、代码、执行、分析和写作),33项要求和150项次级要求,共有1 173项二进制清单项目。
我们从招聘的研究人员自己的项目中收集代理会议和全部工作空间。
就会话背景而言,我们选择一个真正的用户请求作为任务边界,保留其要求,并利用背景部分总结以前仍然有效的请求,平均涵盖10.3个先前的请求。
对于在建的工作空间,我们不清理就将完整的工作空间重放到边界,平均每项任务保存41.1个文件,65.3%的任务是先前的代理文件。 角色只接收指令和工作空间,并用意向对齐的字段编译到任何有效解决方案的列表中.

blocks.en:
We evaluate seven frontier models with three rollouts per task by instance success rate (ISR), the fraction of tasks whose checklist items all pass.
GPT-6.1-Sol and Claude Opus 5.5 reach 66.2% and 56.9% ISR, while the other five models stay below 40% and Qwen3.8-27B reaches only 25.8% (Figure 1 , left).
Checklist item success rate (CSR), which gives partial credit, spans only 13.1 points across models, whereas ISR spans 40.4 points, so models satisfy most items but differ in meeting all of them.
For the same actor deliveries, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash, and Kimi-K3 each reach about 69% ISR when only delivery contracts and general norms are checked. Including historical and material or workspace requirements lowers their ISR to 40.0%, 31.6%, and 28.4%. Under the full checklist, the gap between DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Kimi-K3 grows from 0.44 to 11.56 points, showing that contextual requirements reveal delivery gaps masked by narrower checks.
For session context, real sessions move between research stages, but stage ability is uneven across models. Kimi-K3 ranks third on Code but last on Writing, Qwen3.8-Max ranks fourth overall but second on Writing, and Claude Opus 5.5 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash lead Design and Data & Env., so an evaluation covering a single stage would rank models differently.
Design and Execution rank among the three hardest stages for every model, where the best and worst models differ by 35.8 and 37.4 points, compared with 15.0 points on the easiest stage, Data & Env. (Figure 1 , right).
Claude Opus 5.5 also costs 2.6 times as much per run as GPT-6.1-Sol yet trails it by 9.3 points in ISR.
blocks.zh:
我们评估了七个前沿模式,每个任务有三项成功率,其中一小部分任务的清单项目都通过。
GPT-6.1-Sol和Claude Opus 5.5达到66.2%和56.9%的ISR,而其他5种型号则保持在40%以下,Qune3.8-27B只达到25.8%(图1,左方).
明细表项目成功率(CSR)给予部分功劳,跨模型只跨13.1分,而ISR则跨40.4分,因此模型满足大多数项目,但在满足所有项目方面却有所不同.
对于同一演员的交付,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash,GLM-5.3-Flash,以及Kimi-K3在检查交付合同和一般规范时,各达到约69%的ISR. 包括历史和物质或工作空间要求,它们的工业标准降低到40.0%、31.6%和28.4%。 在完整的核对表下,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash和Kimi-K3之间的差距从0.44点增加到11.56点,表明背景要求揭示了通过较窄的检查掩盖的交付差距.
就会话背景而言,真正的会话介于研究阶段之间,但不同模型的舞台能力不均匀. Kimi-K3在代码上排名第三,但在写作上排名最后,Qwen3.8-Max在写作上总体排名第四,但在写作上排名第二,Claude Opus 5.5和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash铅设计和数据 & Env.,因此涵盖一个单一阶段的评价会给模型分级不同.
设计与执行位列每个型号最难的三个阶段,其中最佳与最差型号的分数分别为35.8分和37.4分,而最简单型号的分数为15.0分 Data & Env. (图1,右).
Claude Opus 5.5也比GPT-6.1-Sol的每跑多2.6倍,但在ISR中却比它落后9.3分.

blocks.en: • We introduce ARE-bench to evaluate whether research agents advance ongoing projects while respecting prior decisions and existing workspace state, with 75 tasks drawn from real researcher sessions and paired with replayed in-progress workspaces. • We map each checklist item to one of 207 sub-requirements across seven stages, covering 150 of them and all 33 requirements, and aggregate these labels into a requirement profile for each task. • We evaluate seven frontier models and find that the strongest reaches only 66.2% ISR, that requirements carried over from the session and workspace expose failures and model differences hidden by checks limited to delivery contracts and general norms, and that stage rankings diverge from overall rankings.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Research-agent benchmarks cover scientific work at different scopes, with success defined by the outcomes each task requires. For specialized research activities, RE-Bench and MLE-bench assess research-engineering and competition performance ( Wijk et al., 2024 ; Chan et al., 2024 ) ; ScienceAgentBench and SWE-bench Science evaluate scientific programming and software tasks ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2026c ) , while SUPER and ResearchEnvBench target repository execution and runtime preparation ( Bogin et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . AARRI-Bench evaluates granular research scenarios involving drafts, logs, and other research artifacts ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . These settings tie acceptance to a specified engineering or research deliverable. Broader coverage includes AstaBench’s heterogeneous scientific suite, including literature-query tasks drawn from user logs, with member-specific metrics ( Bragg et al., 2025 ) , alongside benchmarks organized around reproduction or experimental outcomes. PaperBench and CORE-Bench assess paper replication and computational reproduction ( Starace et al., 2025 ; Siegel et al., 2024 ) ; ResearchGym evaluates research outcomes against baselines, while EXP-Bench assesses experiment execution and conclusions ( Garikaparthi et al., 2026 ; Kon et al., 2025 ) . For scientific-output evaluation, ResearchClawBench anchors rubric-based judgments to a hidden reference study ( Xu et al., 2026b ) . Together, these benchmarks move from specialized research activities to broader scientific workflows while retaining task-specific acceptance targets. ARE-bench takes the current research delegation as its acceptance boundary, compiling requested deliverables and applicable inherited scientific constraints into a checklist. Compared with full-experiment or reference-study targets, this scope supports diagnosing unmet requirements and accepting alternative valid implementations without requiring completion of the surrounding study.
blocks.zh: 研究代理人基准涵盖不同范围的科学工作,每项任务所需的成果界定成功。 就专门研究活动而言,RE-Bench和MLE-bench评估研究-工程和竞争业绩(Wijk等人,2024年;Chan等人,2024年);ScienceAgent Bench和SWE-bench Science评价科学编程和软件任务(Chen等人,2024年;Xu等人,2026年c),而SUPER和ResearchEnv Bench目标存储器执行和运行时间准备(Bogin等人,2024年;Wang等人,2026年b). AARRI-Bench评价涉及草案、原木和其他研究文物的颗粒式研究设想(Wang等人,2026a)。 这些设置将接受与指定的工程或研究交付品挂钩。 更宽泛的涵盖范围包括Asta Bench的多样科学套件,包括从用户日志中提取的文献清空任务,以及成员特有的衡量标准(Bragg等人,2025年),以及围绕复制或实验结果制定的基准。 Paper Bench和CORE-Bench评估纸张复制和计算复制(Starace等人,2025年;Siegel等人,2024年);ResearchGym根据基线评价研究成果,EXP-Bench评估实验执行和结论(Garikaparthi等人,2026年;Kon等人,2025年)。 在科学-产出评价方面,ResearchClaw Bench将基于文字的判断作为隐性参考研究的基础(徐等人,2026年b)。 这些基准共同从专门研究活动转向更广泛的科学工作流程,同时保留特定任务的接受目标。 ARE-bench将目前的研究授权作为其接受范围,将所要求的可交付成果和适用的遗传科学限制汇编成一份清单。 与全面实验或参考研究目标相比,这一范围支持诊断未满足的要求,接受替代有效的执行而无需完成周边研究.

blocks.en: An evaluation’s starting point determines which prior work an agent must continue. Existing benchmarks provide several forms of task state: some Terminal-Bench tasks start with task-specific repository changes ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) ; OSWorld configures application and file states, while τ \tau -bench evaluates tool-mediated conversations against database goals ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2024 ) . LongDS-Bench accumulates analytical state across notebook-derived dialogues ( Xu et al., 2026a ) . For usage-derived tasks, the additional question is how a recorded request and its surrounding work become the evaluation input. SWE-bench pairs issue reports with repository snapshots ( Jimenez et al., 2023 ) . At session entry, K-Bench samples real first-turn scientific requests, while SWE-Together starts from a coding session’s initial request ( Brueckner et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . Other benchmarks reconstruct the starting point: RealClawBench rewrites requests into standalone instructions with sanitized standalone workspaces ( Lv et al., 2026 ) , and REAP backs out accepted solution changes from a current monorepo ( Jha et al., 2026 ) . DuMateBench most directly addresses historical continuation by selecting a local objective, retaining visible history, and restoring recoverable pre-cutoff files; it combines deterministic checks with artifact rubrics ( Niu et al., 2026 ) . ARE-bench focuses on subsequent requests in real research projects, pairing recovered in-progress workspaces with Background summaries of still-valid prior context, current Requirements, and Environment. Compared with DuMateBench’s general-workflow setting, its research-specific requirements and mapping of checklist items to experiment execution, result analysis, and writing support diagnosis of unmet work by research activity.
blocks.zh: 评估的起点决定了代理人必须继续开展哪些先前的工作。 现有基准提供了几种任务状态:一些终端-奔驰任务从任务特定寄存器的改变开始(Merrill等人,2026年);OSWorld配置应用程序和文件状态,而\tau-bench则根据数据库目标评价工具调解的对话(Xie等人,2024年;姚等人,2024年). LongDS-Bench通过笔记本生成的对话框积累分析状态(徐等人,2026a.). 对于用法产生的任务,另一个问题是记录的请求及其周围的工作如何成为评价投入。 SWE-bench对发布带有寄存器快照的报告(Jimenez等人,2023年). 在会话条目中,K-Bench对真实的第一回合科学请求进行采样,而SWE-Togle则从编码会话初始请求开始(Brueckner等人,2026年;Wu等人,2026年). 其他基准重建了起点:RealClaw Bench将请求重写为独立指令,并带有消毒的独立工作空间(Lv等人,2026年),REAP从当前单雷波(Jha等人,2026年)中背出可接受的解决方案变化. blocks.en: 3.2.1 Curator

The Curator filters raw researcher sessions in six steps. It normalizes each session into ordered turns and events that keep their source positions. Reading user turns alone, it splits the session into episodes, recovers goals and requirements with their revisions, and flags feedback signals such as rejections or requests to redo work. It then verifies each requirement against the full interaction, including agent replies, tool results, and produced files, and attributes each confirmed problem to its cause. Verified requirements are labeled with the research requirement taxonomy of Appendix B and rated for difficulty, and each label cites quoted evidence. After schema and evidence prechecks, an episode is selected only if it satisfies four rules:

blocks.en: 3.2.3 Validator

The Validator tests each task in four steps and returns failing tasks to the Builder for revision. Calibration scores three deliveries with the checklist judge. The original agent’s output, when available, tests whether each verdict cites evidence present in the delivery. It calibrates the judge rather than serving as an answer key, because later turns often show that it fell short. An empty delivery should score near zero, and a fabricated delivery that looks complete but contains false content should score clearly below actor runs. Verification then confirms three properties. The replayed state matches the audited state for every file the task uses, the instruction and workspace contain no information from after the cut point, and the released environment installs and imports the required dependencies. In the actor rollout, an agent runs the task and the judge scores each item with cited evidence, yielding ISR and CSR. When every item passes, the Builder rechecks rubric coverage and strictness but does not add uninferable items to lower the score. In human review, the task author checks every failed item. A task proceeds to peer review only when each failure is a valid item that the actor genuinely missed. Otherwise the instruction or rubric is revised and the task is rerun.

blocks.en: 3.4 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.4 评价议定书

blocks.en: For each task, an actor receives the instruction and the restored workspace, works under the declared tool and time limits, and submits a delivery y c y_{c} containing the artifacts listed in the instruction. The checklist evaluator reads y c y_{c} and the minimum input source needed to verify a claimed change. It then assigns each r c , k r_{c,k} using the checklist item’s evidence rule. Missing artifacts, unresolvable claims, and unsupported conclusions receive zero for the affected checklist item.

blocks.en: The evaluation preserves both the request context and the project’s in-progress state. Background carries forward earlier user requests that remain in effect, Requirements specifies the current deliverables and acceptance conditions, and Environment states the available resources and limits. The restored workspace retains unfinished artifacts, outdated versions, and prior failed attempts, requiring the actor to interpret the current request against existing project materials. Checklist items and provenance remain hidden from the actor and support scoring and audit.

blocks.en: Current models remain unreliable at completing research requests in real workspaces. As Table 5 shows, even the strongest model, GPT-6.1-Sol, achieves only about 66.2% strict task success, leaving roughly one-third of runs unable to satisfy all task requirements. Claude Opus 5.5 reaches 56.9%, all remaining models stay below 40%, and Qwen3.8-27B achieves only about 25.8%. Real research requests build on prior work. Background summarizes earlier requests still in effect, and Requirements specifies the current delivery and acceptance conditions, whose project-specific meaning must be interpreted through the restored code, papers, configurations, and logs. Full completion therefore requires models to situate the current request within its project context and identify the requirements that the current changes must continue to satisfy.
blocks.zh: 在实际工作空间完成研究请求时,目前的模型仍然不可靠。 如表5所示,即使是最强的模型GPT-6.1-Sol,也只实现了约66.2%的严格任务成功率,使得大约三分之一的运行无法满足所有任务要求. 克劳德·奥普斯5.5达到56.9%,所有剩余型号都保持在40%以下,而Qune3.8-27B只达到约25.8%. 真正的研究请求是在以前工作的基础上提出的。 背景总结了仍然生效的早先的请求,要求规定了目前的交付和接受条件,其具体项目的含义必须通过恢复的代码、文件、配置和日志加以解释。 因此,要全面完成这项工作,就需要各种模式将目前的请求置于其项目范围内,并确定当前变革必须继续满足的要求。

blocks.en: CSR exceeds overall ISR for every model, ranging from 79.66% to 92.72%. Qwen3.8-Max’s higher ISR but lower CSR than GLM-5.3-Flash is consistent with these definitions: ISR measures fully successful deliveries, while CSR measures average checklist completion across tasks, so the metrics need not rank models identically. The per-run failure distribution clarifies this gap: of GPT-6.1-Sol’s 76 failed runs, 47 miss only one or two checklist items, accounting for 61.84%, and this share ranges from 53.09% to 72.06% across the seven models. Many failures therefore occur after the model has made progress and satisfied most checklist items. Full delivery requires models to jointly address the current request and project requirements still in effect. Even after resolving the most prominent issue in the current turn, overlooking prior agreements in Background or methodological requirements carried by the workspace can leave critical gaps. RQ2 examines how these gaps manifest in archived deliveries. Figure 4 breaks down the strongest model’s failures.
blocks.zh: 每种型号的CSR都超过了总的ISR,从79.66%到92.72%不等. Qune3.8-Max的ISR较高但CSR低于GLM-5.3-Flash符合这些定义:ISR测量完全成功交付,而CSR测量整个任务的平均核对表完成情况,因此度量表不需要同样排序模型. 每一次运行失败分布澄清了这一差距:在GPT-6.1-Sol的76次运行失败中,47次只漏掉了一两个清单项目,占61.84%,这占7个模型的53.09%至72.06%。 因此,许多失败发生在模型取得进展并满足大多数清单项目之后。 全面交付需要各种模式共同满足目前的请求和仍然有效的项目要求。 即使在解决了目前这一轮最突出的问题之后,在背景或工作空间采用的方法要求方面对先前的协议的忽略仍可能留下重大空白。 RQ2审查了这些差距如何在存档交货中表现出来。 图4列出了最强模型的失败。

blocks.en: Table 6 identifies correctness as the lowest-scoring dimension for all seven models. Correctness ISR ranges from 31.11% to 71.11%, compared with 72.00%–87.56% for completeness and 79.11%–93.78% for constraint compliance. The same pattern holds for CSR, with correctness lowest for every model. At the run level, 85.5%–92.8% of failures include an unmet correctness item. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash reaches 93.16% completeness CSR but only 47.11% correctness ISR and 39.56% overall ISR, illustrating the gap between delivery coverage and content reliability.
blocks.zh: 表6将正确性确定为所有7种模型的最低评分维度。 ISR的正确性在31.11%至71.11%之间,完整性为72.00=87.56%,遵守约束规定为79.11=93.78%。 公司社会责任也一样,每个模型的正确性最低。 在运行中,85.5%的失败包括一个未实现的正确性项目。 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash达到93.16%的完整CSR,但只有47.11%的正确ISR和39.56%的总ISR,说明交付覆盖面和内容可靠性之间的差距.

blocks.en: Research requirements must hold throughout implementation and validation, as local functional recovery can still lose methodological meaning. RQ1 concerns whether models integrate the context needed for a task, while Table 6 shows the difficulty of accurately realizing its requirements in research artifacts. The current request may ask only for training repair or framework adaptation, but the model must also preserve the original method and engineering conventions using Background and the papers, code, and design documents in the workspace. The archived examples in Table 7 show the consequences of failing to implement these requirements. The CylindFormer repair retains the KPConv name but omits neighborhood and kernel-point aggregation, while the Graph RAG adaptation implements a local workflow without isolating indexes across datasets. Delivering files or code can satisfy some completeness requirements while deviations between the method and its implementation fail correctness items.
blocks.zh: 研究要求必须贯穿整个实施和验证过程,因为地方功能恢复仍然可能失去方法意义。 RQ1关注模型是否融合了某项任务所需的背景,而表6则显示了在研究文物中准确实现其要求的困难. 目前的请求可能只要求培训修理或框架调整,但模型还必须保留原始方法和工程惯例,使用背景和工作空间的文件、代码和设计文件。 表7的存档例子显示了未能执行这些要求的后果。 CylindFormer修复保留了KPConv名称,但省略了邻里和内核点集合,而Graph RAG的适应则执行一个本地工作流程,而不将索引隔开数据集. 交付文件或代码可以满足一些完整性要求,而方法与其执行之间的偏差则不能正确项目.

blocks.en: Table 7: Failure manifestations and archived examples. These selected qualitative examples explain why checklist items fail. They do not constitute a uniform classification or frequency analysis of all failures.
blocks.zh: 表7:失败表现和存档实例。 这些选定的定性例子解释了清单项目为何失败。 它们并不构成对所有故障的统一分类或频率分析。

blocks.en: These examples illustrate the difficulty of full delivery through method preservation, requirement implementation, and evidence checking. Models must interpret Background and Requirements together and verify that the requirements still hold against existing workspace artifacts after making changes. For example, resuming training also requires checking the original method’s key computations, and adapting a framework requires checking its behavior across datasets. Reliable continuation means advancing the current work while maintaining the project’s existing requirements.
blocks.zh: 这些例子说明,通过方法保存、要求执行和证据核对,难以全面交付。 模型必须共同解释背景和要求,并核实这些要求在作出修改后仍然与现有的工作空间文物相对应。 例如,恢复培训还需要检查原始方法的关键计算,而调整一个框架则需要检查其跨数据集的行为。 可靠的延续意味着在维持项目现有需求的同时推进目前的工作。

blocks.zh: 浮点心

blocks.en: Real research requests often briefly describe only the current work, leaving some requirements and constraints implicit in prior agreements and project materials rather than restating them in the current turn. In ARE-bench, Background summarizes historical constraints, while papers, code, configurations, and existing results in the workspace clarify the specific meaning of methods and acceptance conditions. The agent must therefore interpret the current request within the project context and identify requirements that its changes must continue to respect. To examine these gaps, we hold actor deliveries and item-level judge verdicts fixed and change only the checklist items included in ISR. We first check delivery contracts and general professional norms, then add historical and material or workspace requirements, and finally check the complete checklist. Table 8 contrasts three models with similar scores under the first scope.
blocks.zh: 真正的研究要求往往只简要地叙述目前的工作,在以前的协定和项目材料中留下一些隐含的要求和限制,而不是在目前的情况中重复这些要求和限制。 在ARE-bench中,背景总结了历史制约因素,而文件,代码,配置,以及工作空间中的现有结果则澄清了方法和接受条件的具体含义. 因此,代理商必须在项目范围内解释当前的要求,并确定其改变必须继续遵守的要求。 为了审查这些差距,我们将确定行为者交付和项目级法官的判决,并仅修改《国际审计准则》所列的清单项目。 我们首先检查交货合同和一般专业规范,然后增加历史和材料或工作空间要求,最后检查完整的核对表。 表8对比了第一个范围下三个得分相似的模型.

Each column requires all applicable items within its scope to pass, reusing the same deliveries and item verdicts. Delivery contracts and general norms correspond to contract + norm . The second scope adds inherited + anchored , while the full checklist also includes latent items discovered through subsequent rework but inferable at the task cut point. Darker blue indicates higher ISR on a shared quadratic percentage scale.

blocks.en: As Table 8 shows, all three models achieve approximately 69% ISR when only delivery contracts and general norms are checked. Adding historical and material or workspace requirements reduces DeepSeek, GLM, and Kimi to 40.00%, 31.56%, and 28.44%, respectively. Among runs passing the first group of checks, 66, 85, and 93 still fail at least one historical or material or workspace requirement, accounting for 48.5%, 54.5%, and 57.4% of each model’s total failed runs. DeepSeek and Kimi differ by only 0.44 percentage points under the first scope, compared with 11.56 points under the full checklist.
blocks.zh: 如表8所示,所有三种模式在只检查交货合同和一般规范时都达到大约69%的ISR。 添加历史和材料或工作空间要求将DeepSeek、GLM和Kimi分别降低到40.00%、31.56%和28.44%。 在通过第一组检查的检查中,66、85和93项仍然至少没有达到一项历史或材料或工作空间要求,占每个模型全部失败的48.5%、54.5%和57.4%。 DeepSeek和Kimi在第一个范围下只差0.44个百分点,而在完整清单下则差11.56个百分点.

blocks.en: An important bottleneck in real research delivery is satisfying implicit requirements that remain binding through project context but are not restated in the current turn. Roughly half of the failed runs for these three models satisfy delivery contracts and general norms yet are blocked by historical or material or workspace requirements. Thus, even a model that performs the action described in the current request may fail to deliver a usable result because it departs from prior research agreements, material-grounded methods, or the computations the project requires. Reliable research continuation requires the agent to integrate these distributed constraints and preserve them throughout modification and validation.
blocks.zh: 实际研究交付中的一个重要瓶颈是满足通过项目背景仍然具有约束力的隐含要求,但目前的情况不再重述。 大约一半的这三种模式的失败运行满足交货合同和一般规范,但因历史或材料或工作空间要求而受阻。 因此,即使是执行本请求所述行动的模式,也可能无法产生可用结果,因为它背离了先前的研究协议、基于材料的方法或项目所需的计算。 可靠研究的继续需要代理人综合这些分布式制约,并在整个修改和验证过程中加以保存.

blocks.en: This capability requirement connects back to the distinction in task granularity and starting state established earlier. Compared with a setting that pursues a standalone end-to-end objective from an initial state, ARE-bench starts at a user request within an ongoing real project, retaining historical agreements still in effect in Background and existing artifacts in the cut-point workspace. Evaluation concerns both achieving the current objective and maintaining the project’s existing research requirements while doing so. Table 8 shows that this dimension reveals capability differences that are difficult to observe when only delivery contracts and general norms are checked.

blocks.zh: 表9和表10显示,设计和执行是每个模型最困难的三个阶段之一。 7种模式的ISR为86.43%的数据和Env.,编码为71.28%,设计为59.47%,执行为57.43%。 设计和实施模型之间的差距最大,分别为35.77和37.37个百分点。 阶段优势不同:GPT-6.1-Sol领导五个阶段, Claude Opus 5.5领导设计,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash领导Data & Env. Kimi-K3在代码中以73.96%排名第三,但其执行和写作的分数只有47.47%和47.31%,分别排名第二和最后.

blocks.en: Strength in code implementation does not yet ensure effective research work. Dependency installation and code executability provide relatively direct verification feedback. Design and Execution additionally require judging whether an experiment can answer the research question and taking appropriate action based on existing scripts, logs, and checkpoints. These stage differences indicate that implementation strength must be assessed separately in subsequent execution, validation, and reporting. A single score cannot capture this capability distribution. Stages come from naturally occurring research sessions, so this interpretation concerns the evaluated task distribution. Future ablations can further distinguish the contributions of context and workspace state.
blocks.zh: 执行守则的力量尚不能确保有效的研究工作。 依赖性安装和代码可执行性提供了相对直接的核查反馈. 设计和执行还需要判断一项实验是否能够回答研究问题,并根据现有的脚本、日志和检查站采取适当行动。 这些阶段的差异表明,必须在随后的执行、鉴定和报告方面分别评估执行力度。 单分无法捕捉到这种能力分布. 阶段来自自然发生的研究会议,因此这种解释涉及评估的任务分配。 未来的崩盘可以进一步区分上下文和工作空间状态的贡献.

After selection, earlier requests still in effect are summarized in Background, the current request and delivery and acceptance conditions are retained in Requirements, and the workspace is replayed to the cut point. blocks.en: Figure 5 shows that neither peak context nor cost aligns with strict success across models. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash reaches a peak context of 132.55K, close to the 142.87K of GPT-6.1-Sol, but achieves 39.56% ISR compared with 66.22%. Claude Opus 5.5 and Qwen3.8-27B reach similar peak contexts of 104.71K and 108.02K, yet their ISR differs by 31.11 percentage points. Under the frozen prices, GPT-6.1-Sol costs about USD 2.17 per run and Claude Opus 5.5 about USD 5.69, roughly 2.62 times as much for an ISR lower by 9.33 percentage points. GLM-5.3-Flash and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash offer 30.67% and 39.56% ISR at approximately USD 0.20 and USD 0.53, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图5显示,峰值背景和成本都与各种模型的严格成功不相适应。 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash达到顶峰背景值132.55K,接近GPT-6.1-Sol的142.87K,但与66.22%相比达到了39.56%的ISR. 克劳德·奥普斯·5.5和Quen3.8-27B 达到104.71K和108.02K的类似峰值背景,然而,它们的IRS却差31.11个百分点。 根据冻结价格,GPT-6.1-Sol每跑约2.17美元,Claude Opus 5.5约5.69美元,比ISR低9.33个百分点约2.62倍。 GLM-5.3-Flash和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash分别以约0.20美元和0.53美元的价格提供30.67%和39.56%的ISR。

blocks.en: Larger contexts and higher costs do not automatically produce more reliable research deliveries. Under this task distribution and these frozen prices, GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and GPT-6.1-Sol form the cost-success Pareto frontier, offering choices at different cost levels. The additional resources spent on longer trajectories constitute progress only when they satisfy research requirements. These results suggest that the value of resource use lies in helping models check constraints, complete validation, and resolve remaining errors. Cross-model comparisons reveal this efficiency difference, while the benefit of increasing a single model’s budget requires a separate experiment.
blocks.zh: 更大的背景和更高的成本不会自动产生更可靠的研究成果。 在这一任务分配和这些冷冻价格下,GLM-5.3-Flash、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash和GPT-6.1-Sol构成成本-成功帕雷托边界,以不同成本水平提供选择。 用于较长轨道的额外资源只有在满足研究要求时才构成进展。 这些结果表明,资源使用的价值在于帮助模型检查制约因素、完成验证和解决剩余的错误。 跨模型比较揭示了这种效率差异,而增加单一模型预算的好处则需要单独进行试验。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: ARE-bench evaluates the next research action inside an evolving project. Every task starts from the replayed mid-session workspace with unfinished files and failed attempts preserved, while its task brief gives the actor a self-contained and auditable specification. The ISR and CSR checklist metrics expose strict completion and partial compliance, while separate cost metrics expose efficiency trade-offs. Replay checks and anonymization make the benchmark suitable for comparing research agents without treating an original trajectory as a gold answer. The release protocol supports filling the result schema as model runs become available while keeping the benchmark definition fixed.
blocks.zh: ARE-bench评价一个不断发展的项目中的下一个研究行动. 每一个任务都从重播的中段工作空间开始,保留了未完成的文件和失败的尝试,而它的任务简报则给演员一个自成一体的,可审计的规格. IRS和CSR核对表的衡量标准显示严格完成和部分遵守,而单独的成本衡量标准显示效率权衡。 重放检查和匿名使基准适合比较研究代理,而不将原始的轨迹当作黄金答案. 发布协议支持在模型运行时填补结果计划,同时保持基准定义的固定.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The source sessions may overrepresent particular projects, tools, or researcher populations. Cut-point sampling from existing sessions does not guarantee coverage of all research workflows. Replay and dependency recovery can lose context that was available to the original researcher, and anonymization can remove clues needed for faithful interpretation. Rubric writing remains a human judgment process, and a checklist evaluator can still miss evidence or over-credit a plausible claim. GPT-6.1-Sol runs with the Codex harness and the other models with Claude Code, so cross-model differences reflect the model and harness together. The benchmark therefore publishes provenance records for audit, but its scores should be interpreted as evidence about the released task distribution rather than as a universal measure of scientific ability.
blocks.zh: 来源会议可能过多地代表特定项目、工具或研究人员。 现有会议的切点抽样不能保证涵盖所有研究工作流程。 重播和依赖性恢复可能失去原研究者可用的上下文,匿名化可以去除忠实解释所需的线索. 鲁布里克写作仍然是一个人性的判断过程,核对表评估员仍然可能错过证据,或者过度认证一种可信的说法。 GPT-6.1-Sol与Codex吊带运行,其他型号则与Claude Code运行,因此跨型号的区别反应了模型,并一起牵引. 因此,该基准公布审计的出处记录,但其分数应被解释为关于所发布任务分配的证据,而不是科学能力的普遍衡量标准。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: Session data must be collected under an appropriate authorization or consent arrangement. Before release, identifiers, private paths, credentials, unpublished data, and organization-specific metadata are removed or replaced with stable aliases. The provenance package is access-controlled and is not included in actor inputs. We release only the minimum workspace content needed to reproduce each task and document residual disclosure risks, withdrawal procedures, and the scope of permitted reuse.
blocks.zh: 会议数据必须在适当的授权或同意安排下收集。 在发布前,识别符,私人路径,证书,未公布的数据,以及组织特有的元数据都被删除或替换为稳定的别名. 出处包由访问控制,不包含在演员投入中. 我们只公布复制每项任务所需的最低工作空间内容,并记录剩余披露风险、退出程序和允许再利用的范围。

blocks.en: Appendix A Task and Rubric Example
blocks.zh: 附录A 任务和Rubric 示例

blocks.en: A task contains an instruction with Background, Requirements, and Environment sections. A representative requirements block asks the agent to update an existing analysis, save the result to an absolute path, preserve a named preprocessing choice, and report the command used to reproduce the artifact. Its rubric compiles into one binary checklist item for each deliverable, required transformation, preservation constraint, and reproducibility condition. The actor never sees the rubric text.
blocks.zh: 一项任务包含一份附有背景、要求和环境部分的说明。 一个具有代表性的要求块要求代理商更新现有的分析,将结果保存到绝对路径,保留一个命名的预处理选择,并报告用于复制文物的命令. 其标题为每个交付品、所需转换、保存限制和可复制条件汇编成一个二进制清单项目。 演员从不看标点文字.

blocks.en: Appendix B Research Requirement Taxonomy
blocks.zh: 附录B 研究 要求分类

blocks.en: We use a research requirement taxonomy to characterize the kinds of work researchers request from agents. The taxonomy serves as a reference for benchmark construction and organizes research work into 33 requirements and 207 sub-requirements, grouped into seven research stages. Requirements describe broader areas of work, such as literature review, experiment design, and code testing. Sub-requirements specify individual user needs using action–object descriptions, such as searching for relevant literature or writing unit tests. Table 14 presents the portion of this taxonomy represented in our benchmark: 150 sub-requirements covering all 33 requirements.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个研究要求分类法来描述 研究者要求的代理工种。 分类学是基准构建的参考,将研究工作分为33项要求和207项次要求,分为七个研究阶段。 要求描述了更广泛的工作领域,如文献审查,实验设计和代码测试. 次要求使用动作-对象描述来指定个人用户需求,如搜索相关文献或写单位测试. 表14列出我国基准中这一分类法的部分:150项次级要求,涵盖所有33项要求。

blocks.en: The table organizes research requirements into three levels: research stage, requirement, and sub-requirement. Two additional attributes characterize each sub-requirement. Capability primitives are drawn from the cognitive process dimension of the revised Bloom’s taxonomy ( Anderson and Krathwohl, 2001 ; Krathwohl, 2002 ) and describe the cognitive operations involved, such as differentiating under Analyze, checking under Evaluate, and planning under Create. Work object identifies the material these operations act on, such as code, data, or research documents.
blocks.zh: 该表将研究要求分为三个层次:研究阶段、要求和次要求。 每个次级要求都有另外两个属性特征. 能力原始来源于修订的Bloom分类法的认知过程维度(Anderson and Krathwohl,2001;Krathwohl,2002),并描述了相关的认知操作,如分析、评估、规划。 工作对象确定这些操作所操作的材料,例如代码、数据或研究文件。

blocks.en: Each checklist item is associated with one sub-requirement, which identifies its parent requirement and research stage. A task can therefore involve several requirements and stages through its checklist items.
blocks.zh: 每个清单项目都与一项次级要求有关,后者确定了其母要求和研究阶段。 因此,一项任务可以通过其清单项目涉及若干要求和阶段。

blocks.en: Table 14: Research requirement taxonomy represented in the benchmark. Each row describes a sub-requirement, its parent requirement and research stage, and the associated capability primitives and work object.
blocks.zh: 表14:基准中反映的研究要求分类。 每行描述一个子要求,其母要求和研究阶段,以及相关能力原始和工作对象.

blocks.en: The builder records the source episode, user-turn index, file-event range, process-event range, dependency snapshot, and validation hash. Replay is accepted only when the reconstructed tree matches the audited state for all files declared relevant to the task. Paths, usernames, hostnames, keys, and dataset identifiers are replaced by deterministic aliases. A second reviewer checks that the replacement preserves references used in the instruction and does not leak the source project.
blocks.zh: 构建者记录了源集,用户翻转索引,文件事件范围,过程事件范围,依赖快照,以及验证散列. 重播只有在重建的树与被审计的状态相匹配时,所有被宣布与任务相关的文件才会被接受. 路径,用户名,主机名,密钥,和数据集标识符被确定化名所取代. 第二评审员检查该替换是否保留了指令中使用的引用,不会泄露源项目.

blocks.en: Appendix E Case Study: Repairing an Interrupted Training Experiment
blocks.zh: 附录E 案例研究:修复中断培训实验

blocks.en: This case follows a request to repair an unfinished image–point-cloud registration experiment, which matches photographs to a three-dimensional scene to estimate camera pose. Training has started, but the coarse-matching loss stays at zero and each iteration takes about 28 seconds. The repair must preserve the supplied paper’s method.
blocks.zh: 这个案例是根据一项要求修复一个未完成的图像-点-云注册实验,该实验将照片与三维场景相匹配,以估计相机的姿势. 训练已经开始,但粗配损失保持在零,每次迭代大约需要28秒. 修复必须保留所提供的纸张方法。

blocks.en: Figure 8 shows the real session. We cut after the fourth user turn, the repair request. Earlier decisions supply Background; the implementation at this boundary supplies the repair starting point. Figure 9 separates the complete task instruction from the restored workspace and prepared execution resources. Assessment material is shown separately from actor input.
blocks.zh: 图8显示的是真实的会话。 在第四个用户转弯后,我们剪切 修复请求。 早先的决定提供了背景;这一边界的执行提供了修复起点。 图9将完整的任务指令与恢复的工作空间和准备的执行资源分开。 评估材料与行为者投入分开显示。

blocks.en: Figure 8: Session with all six user turns and brief assistant excerpts. The star marks the cut after the repair request. Later turns appear below the boundary and are excluded from task construction.
blocks.zh: 图8:所有6个用户轮流的会话和简短的助理摘要。 恒星在修补请求后标记了切割. 后来转弯出现在边界下方,被排除在任务构建之外.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Task inputs and assessment. Background, Requirements, and Environment form instruction.md ; the other two input regions describe the provided files and execution resources. Paths are normalized. The complete outcome rubric appears in Table 16 .
blocks.zh: 图 9:任务投入和评估。 背景、要求和环境表指示.md;另外两个输入区域描述所提供的文件和执行资源。 道路正常化。 整个结果标题见表16。

blocks.en: Recorded file operations restore the unfinished data-loading, model, loss, and training code. The paper defines the method to preserve; the diagnostic log records the observed failure. Public data and pretrained weights are restored separately, with compatible dependencies. Figure 10 shows every recovered project and materials file and the prepared resource directories.
blocks.zh: 记录的文件操作恢复未完成的数据加载,模型,丢失,和训练代码. 论文定义了保存的方法;诊断日志记录了观察到的故障. 公共数据和预先训练的权重分别恢复,具有兼容的依赖性. 图10显示每个回收的项目和材料档案以及已编制的资源目录。

blocks.en: Figure 10: Directory view of the starting inputs: all 18 project files and four materials files, plus separately prepared data and model resources. Repeated raw-data samples use a filename pattern; weight entries name their models. The output directory is the requested handoff destination.
blocks.zh: 图10:初始投入目录视图:全部18个项目文件和4个材料文件,外加单独编制的数据和模型资源. 重复的原始数据样本使用文件名模式;重量项命名他们的模型. 输出目录是请求的交接对象.

blocks.en: Both executions continue training, but progress alone does not establish a faithful repair. Figure 11 connects the repairs and recorded behavior to the archived outcome assessments. The successful execution passes all 20 checks. The failed execution passes 16, including training recovery, but fails four method checks involving feature coordinates, overlap labels, and loss computation.
blocks.zh: 两次处决都在继续训练,但仅靠进展并不能保证得到忠实的修复。 图11将修复和记录的行为与存档结果评估联系起来. 成功执行通过所有20张支票。 执行失败通过16次,包括培训恢复,但失败了涉及特征坐标、重叠标签和损失计算的四个方法检查。

blocks.en: Figure 11: Two independent executions of the same task. Green and red backgrounds mark the decisive findings. The scores summarize archived outcome assessments; the comparison establishes method consistency or deviation, rather than a measured change in final registration accuracy.
blocks.zh: 图11:执行相同任务的两次独立处决。 绿色和红色的背景标志着决定性的调查结果。 得分汇总存档结果评估;比较确定方法一致性或偏差,而不是最终登记准确度的计量变化.

blocks.en: Restoring the existing code makes the short repair request a continuation of an unfinished experiment. The successful case shows that a usable repair can preserve its method while moving training forward. The failed case shows why observing training is insufficient: the experiment runs, but parts of the method no longer match the paper. Retaining both the project state and the research constraints makes this distinction assessable.
blocks.zh: 恢复现有的代码使得短修请求成为未完成实验的延续. 成功的案例表明,可用修理可以保留其方法,同时推动培训。 失败的案例显示了观察训练为何不足:实验运行,但部分方法已经与论文不符. 既保留项目状态,又保留研究方面的限制,使这一区别可以评估。

blocks.en: The outcome rubric checks a usable handoff, data and method implementation, actual training, and evidence-linked validation. Its source labels distinguish explicit requirements from checks inferred using the paper, prior context, or ordinary research and usability expectations. Detailed method checks draw on the supplied paper and are not all individually enumerated in Requirements.
blocks.zh: 结果主题检查可用的交割、数据和方法执行情况、实际培训和与证据有关的验证。 其来源标签将明确的要求与使用纸张、前上下文或普通研究和可用性预期推断出的检查区分开来。 详细的方法检查借鉴了所提供的纸张,并非全部在要求中单独列出。

blocks.en: Table 16: Complete outcome rubric. Each item is a binary check; source labels identify explicit or inferred grounding.
blocks.zh: 表16:完整结果标题。 每件物品都是二进制检查;源标签表示明显的或推断的搁浅.

blocks.en: The evaluator prompt states the task requirements, the checklist item, the evidence available to inspect, and the binary decision rule. It requires a short evidence citation for every decision and forbids inferring an unobserved result from a claimed completion.

blocks.en: The machine-readable release stores one record per task and rollout with the model identifier, score vector, delivery manifest status, wall-clock time, token counts, tool calls, and steps. Aggregate tables are generated by grouping these records by model, checklist dimension, and research stage. The run manifest is versioned with the task manifest so that a later model evaluation cannot silently alter the benchmark denominator.
